description: Use this when the user has a PDF they want printed and posted and it should be checked first: verifies the page size (A4 or US Letter) and the required free margin on every side, and lists the pages that need changes. We print on the paper size uploaded (printed_on): A4 on A4, US Letter on US Letter (for a recipient outside the US, Canada and US territories the user may choose A4 instead when sending); a PDF mixing A4 and US Letter pages is printed on A4, its Letter pages centred at 100 % or scaled down slightly when content comes close to the edge (us_letter_note, pages[].scale_percent). Decide by compliant: all_pages_a4 is false for a US Letter PDF, which is printable. Accepts a public https URL or base64. The file is not stored and nothing is sent. Works without sign-in. To fix a failing PDF, upload it with upload_document and use fix_document_margins.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF file as base64 (a data:application/pdf;base64, prefix is fine), for files up to about 3 MB. Pass pdf_url or pdf_base64. Larger files: pass pdf_url, or use create_upload_link.

pdf_url.description: Public https URL of the PDF (A4 or US Letter pages), e.g. https://example.com/letter.pdf. Pass pdf_url or pdf_base64.

name: check_pdf_margins
title: Check PDF for printing
